terra.problem: The verse says David constructed buildings for himself; it does not say they were houses.
The text says the elders went with David, but does not say they walked.
The passage does not say speed was not part of the plan or that everybody did everything right.
Moses being Israel's leader before David is a fact from outside this passage and needs a reference.
The singers' appointment does not establish that they were not carrying messages or that everybody in earshot heard them.
The drawer joke has no setup explaining what drawer Papa means, so the image does not connect clearly.
The sacrifice in response to God's help is in the same verse, not the next verse.
Calling the ephod an extra piece implies the others did not wear one. The text says David wore one but does not say whether the others did.
Dancing and celebrating do not establish that David was not weeping; the text simply says what Michal saw.
The passage does not report the priests arguing, but that does not establish that none of them were arguing.
